description.value: Namaste Authentic Indian Cuisine is a full-service Indian restaurant in Salmon Arm situated along the Trans Canada Highway, serving over 50 menu items spanning traditional curries, tandoori preparations from a clay oven, and fusion dishes like Butter Chicken Poutine. With a 100+ person capacity, it offers a substantial sit-down dining experience for cyclists passing through the Okanagan & Thompson corridor. Online ordering is also available for those wanting to eat on the move.

address.value: 200 Trans Canada Highway SW, Salmon Arm, B.C. V1E 4H7
